spec: {"version":5,"panelSettings":{},"blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":""}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"On 46 Hero evaluations at steps 119,999-254,999, the published Uncheatable forecast has 0.03111 RMSE. Using Paloma's log-OLS method and excluding output-head FLOPs, with the existing 1.4 floor, worsens this to 0.06191. Fitting the floor from the H100 ladder alone gives 1.20343 and reduces RMSE to 0.00647. On its own corpus, the original Paloma forecast scores 0.00856 on the same window."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"Paloma's original method uses a fixed 1.5 floor and per-percentile log-OLS on output-head-excluded compute. Here the first transfer keeps Uncheatable's existing 1.4 corpus-specific floor; the repair profiles a shared nonnegative floor across the original/new mixtures and 30-100% ladder progress, minimizing raw-loss SSE after log-OLS. H100 d512-d1536 coverage is held constant between candidates. The original Paloma line used the separate TPU ladder. Hero losses are used only for retrospective scoring."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"The revised new-mixture forecast endpoint is 1.49676 nats/token at the original 390,251-step budget, conditional on 4K evaluation and that schedule. It is not a prediction of the later 16K or 262K metric. The fitted floor is an effective extrapolation parameter; recipe differences and functional-form error remain. The seven-subset macro is fitted directly.
